evals.prompt: Create the GitHub feature issue for spec/invoice-export.md in the billing-api repo.
evals.expected_output: One feature issue created in billing-api from the specification, with the feature_request.yml field headings and its URL reported.
expectations: The agent runs gh issue list --state all --search before any gh issue create call
Exactly one gh issue create call runs, with --body-file and a title taken from the specification's feature name
The issue body contains ### headings matching the fields of .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml
The response ends with the created issue URL

evals.prompt: Create the feature issue from the specification.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks which specification file to use instead of guessing or creating an issue.
expectations: The agent asks for the specification file path
No gh issue create or gh issue edit call runs before the file is named
No issue body is drafted from invented requirements

evals.prompt: Create the feature issue for spec/webhook-retries.md in web-app. There may already be an open issue about webhook retries.
evals.expected_output: The existing issue is found and updated with gh issue edit; no duplicate is created.
expectations: The agent runs gh issue list --state all --search with webhook retries terms and inspects the result
When a matching issue exists, the agent runs gh issue edit <number> --body-file and does not run gh issue create
The response names the matched issue number and URL and says it was updated rather than created
